usage.levelWarn: You are using more than 80% of your space.
usage.levelCritical: You are using more than 95% of your space. Free some space soon.
usage.levelFull: Your space is full: new changes cannot be uploaded until you free some space.

vaults.title: My vaults
vaults.emptyHint: Create a vault from the desktop app and it will appear here.

devices.title: Devices
devices.emptyHint: Devices appear here once you sign in from the desktop app.
devices.confirmBody: “{{name}}” will stop syncing and must sign in again to reconnect.

shares.title: Sharing
shares.ownedEmpty: You have not shared anything yet
shares.ownedEmptyHint: Share a folder or a vault from the desktop app.
shares.receivedEmpty: Nobody has shared anything with you
shares.revokeBody: “{{name}}” will no longer be available to the people it is shared with.

errors.invalidState: This is not allowed in the current state, for example: the last administrator cannot be demoted, suspended or deleted, and you cannot suspend or delete yourself.

quota.invalid: Enter a valid amount (0 or more).

storage.trendTable: Show the data as a table

limits.defaultQuotaHint: Applies to users without a specific quota.
limits.retentionHint: All versions are kept for this long.
limits.dailyHint: Afterwards one version per day is kept until this age.
limits.error_quota: The default quota must be a number, 0 or more.
limits.error_percents: Warning and critical levels must be whole numbers.
limits.error_warnRange: The warning level must be at least 1 and lower than the critical level, which can be at most 100.
limits.error_retention: History retention must be a whole number of days, at least 1.
limits.error_daily: Daily versions retention must be a whole number of days, at least 1.
limits.error_dailyLess: Daily versions retention cannot be shorter than the history retention.
limits.error_maxFile: The maximum file size must be a number.
limits.error_maxFileMin: The maximum file size must be at least 1 KB.

users.createInvalid: A username and a valid e-mail address are required.
users.tempPasswordHint: Without a password the user receives an e-mail to verify the address and must set one at the first sign-in. With a password, the user must change it at the first sign-in.
users.passwordShort: The temporary password needs at least 8 characters.
users.selectAll: Select all users on this page
users.bulkTitle: Set the quota of the selection
users.bulkBody_one: The quota of {{count}} user will change.
users.bulkBody_other: The quota of {{count}} users will change.

user.suspendBody: {{name}} will not be able to sign in or sync until you activate the account again. Their data is kept.
user.resetBody: {{name}} will have to set a new password at the next sign-in. Keycloak sends them an e-mail with the instructions.
user.resetSent: The e-mail was sent. The user must change the password at the next sign-in.
user.resetNotSent: The e-mail could not be sent. The password change is still required at the next sign-in: tell the user.
user.deleteBody: {{name}} will be removed. Their vaults are not erased at once: they enter the retention period and can still be recovered until it ends.
user.vaultsNote: Only metadata is shown: administrators cannot read vault content.
user.effectiveConfigNote: What this user's apps receive after combining the global profile, group profiles and their own settings.

groups.note: Groups exist only in Nodus and are used for sharing and for configuration profiles.
groups.name: Name
groups.deleteBody: {{name}} will be deleted: its shares and configuration profile assignments disappear with it.
groups.removeBody: {{name}} will leave the group and lose what the group gives access to.
groups.profilesNote: Profiles assigned to the group apply to its members. When several apply, the highest priority wins.
groups.priorityHint: Higher numbers win. Saving replaces the whole list.
groups.profilesInvalid: Every row needs a profile and a whole-number priority.
groups.profilesDuplicate: A profile can be assigned only once.

config.note: A profile sets default settings and feature flags for the desktop app. The global profile applies to everyone.
config.name: Name
config.isGlobalHint: Only one profile can be global: making this one global replaces the current one.
config.replacesGlobal: This profile will replace the current global profile, {{name}}.
config.globalBody: {{name}} stops being global. All users will receive this profile instead.
config.jsonNotObject: The configuration must be a JSON object.
config.jsonHint: Allowed top-level keys: {{keys}}. The server validates the full schema when you save.
config.lockedHint: One dotted key per line, for example editor.fontSize. Users cannot override locked keys.
config.lockedInvalid: Not valid keys: {{keys}}. A key must start with a top-level key of the schema.
config.deleteBody: {{name}} will be deleted and removed from every group it is assigned to.
config.compareAria: Compare version {{version}} with the current one
config.restoreBody: A new version with the content of version {{version}} is created. Nothing is lost: the current version stays in the history.

forbidden.title: Not allowed
forbidden.body: You do not have access to this page.

vaultExport.downloadPrivateAria: Download ZIP, decrypted in your browser: {{name}}
vaultExport.title: Download {{name}}
vaultExport.sharedNote: Large vaults are prepared in the background; this window waits for them.
vaultExport.job_ready: The export is ready, starting the download…
vaultExport.jobFailed: The export failed on the server: {{error}}
vaultExport.jobExpired: The export is no longer available. Start a new download.
vaultExport.privateIntro: This vault is end-to-end encrypted. Your browser downloads the encrypted files, decrypts them here and builds the ZIP. Nothing leaves your browser in clear and the server never sees your key.
vaultExport.recoveryHint: The recovery key you saved when you created the vault, with or without dashes.
vaultExport.secretRequired: Enter the passphrase or the recovery key.
vaultExport.unlocking: Unlocking the vault… this can take a few seconds.
vaultExport.failure_badRecoveryKey: This is not a valid recovery key. Check it for typing mistakes.
vaultExport.failure_weakKdf: The key derivation settings stored for this vault are not acceptable, so it was not unlocked.
vaultExport.failure_noEnvelope: This vault has no key of this type. Try the other method.
vaultExport.failure_derivation: The key could not be derived in this browser (WebAssembly may be unavailable or blocked by the security policy). The recovery key does not need it: try that instead.
vaultExport.failure_api: The vault data could not be loaded.
vaultExport.saveToDisk: You will choose where to save the ZIP and it is written to disk as it is built.
vaultExport.saveBlob: Your browser cannot write to disk directly: the ZIP is built in memory and downloaded when complete.
vaultExport.memoryWarning: This vault is large and your browser will keep the whole ZIP in memory. Use a Chromium-based browser, or the desktop app, if this fails.
vaultExport.skipped_one: {{count}} file was skipped and is not in the ZIP.
vaultExport.skipped_other: {{count}} files were skipped and are not in the ZIP.
vaultExport.reason_blob_missing: Content not available on the server
